usage: agentbreeder release [-h] [--environment ENVIRONMENT]
                            [--threshold THRESHOLD] [--retries RETRIES]
                            [--rollback] [--state-dir STATE_DIR]
                            [--output OUTPUT] [--json] [--stack DIR]
                            agent

positional arguments:
  agent

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --environment ENVIRONMENT
  --threshold THRESHOLD
  --retries RETRIES
  --rollback            Redeploy the previous production
  --state-dir STATE_DIR
  --output OUTPUT
  --json
  --stack DIR           Use the operator config and state that `services up`
                        wrote for DIR
